papers.title: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
papers.desc: AI agents operate in persistent environments where early state changes can influence decisions far into the future.

papers.title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence
papers.desc: AI models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet the mechanisms underlying their capabilities and the risks they may pose remain poorly understood.

papers.title: Can LLM Agents Stick to the Script? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Consistency in Interactive Narratives

papers.title: Persistent Recursive Worlds Enable Autonomous Software Evolution

papers.title: Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning
papers.desc: Exploration has been a focus of reinforcement learning research for a long time.

papers.title: Hand Visibility Detector: Per-Keypoint Visibility Estimation for Hands

papers.desc: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced embodied AI, their fundamentally reactive paradigm severely limits performance in partially observable and long-horizon tasks.
